overrides.tagline: An interactive, minimalist interior design prototype
overrides.summary: An interactive desktop prototype for interior design visualisation, with a minimalist white-and-brown aesthetic — built with React and Tailwind CSS.
description: Interior design concepts are usually shared as static images in a PDF, which makes it hard for a client to feel the space.
This prototype presents a minimalist living space as an interactive desktop experience, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

features.title: Interactive presentation
features.desc: The concept is explored as an interactive desktop prototype rather than a static deck.

features.title: Minimalist aesthetic
features.desc: A white-and-brown palette with warm light and quiet surfaces.

features.title: React + Tailwind
features.desc: Built as a web prototype, so it runs in a browser.

challenge: Static renders in a PDF don't convey how a space feels. The prototype explores presenting an interior concept interactively instead.
